notes.text: PSYC courses at 2000 and above level will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.

A Psychology Major student who pursues a second Major in Linguistics can be exempted from taking LING3403 and LING3202 by taking PSYC2010 and PSYC3430 respectively. Units earned can be counted towards both Major Programmes.

Students are required to take PSYC2010. Students who have transferred to the Psychology Programme and have taken any of the equivalent statistics courses including COMM3110, DOTE2011, ECON2121, GRMD2102, LING3403, PHPC2015, SEEM2430, SOCI2004, SPED2600, STAT2001 and 2006, STAT2101 and 2102 are exempted from taking PSYC2010, and they are required to take another PSYC (2000 or above level) course listed under 3. Elective Courses to compensate for the units.

Students are required to take PSYC2540. Students who have transferred to the Psychology Programme and have taken SOWK2110 or SOWK2120 or EDUC2310 will be exempted from taking PSYC2540, and they are required to take another PSYC (2000 or above level) course listed under 3. Elective Courses to compensate for the units.

text: At least 6 units of courses chosen from the following:

notes.text: PSYC courses at 2000 and above level as well as those labeled as # will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.

Students may be required to participate in activities such as field trips and study tours that foster their learning of linguistics. Students are responsible for part of or all costs incurred in relation to these activities.

Subject to approval by the Major Programmes concerned, students may opt out of the Double Major Programme and register for the 1st Major Programme only. The decision to opt out is irrevocable. Students who have opted out are required to complete and fulfill all graduation requirements by following the study scheme of the 1st Major Programme as a single major. Students should be aware that such decision may result in a delay in graduation because the requirements of the single major study scheme differ from those of the Double Major Programme.
If the course is not taken to fulfill requirement 1(b), it may be taken as an elective course for fulfillment of requirement 3(b)(iii).

Students are required to take PSYC2010. Psychology and Linguistics Double Major Programme students who have taken any of the equivalent statistics courses including COMM3110, DOTE2011, ECON2121, GRMD2102, LING3403, PHPC2015, SEEM2430, SOCI2004, SPED2600, STAT2001 and 2006, STAT2101 and 2102 are exempted from taking PSYC2010, and they are required to take another PSYC course at 2000 or above listed under 3(a) Elective Courses to compensate for the units.
The course not taken to fulfill requirement 2(b) may be taken as a free elective course.
Old course code used in 2024-25 and before.
